arguments.sql: SELECT t.transaction_type, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) GROUP BY t.transaction_type ORDER BY t.transaction_type
arguments.explanation: For each transaction type (chip, online and swipe), this gives the number of labelled transactions, how many of them are fraud, and the fraud rate as a fraction.
assumptions: Fraud rates count only transactions that have a fraud label. Transactions with no label are left out rather than counted as legitimate.
The query covers all the data, from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
